text:
Boosting Space Station Power to 215 kW

Astronauts are boosting the International Space Station's power from 160 kilowatts to about 215 kilowatts. Spacewalkers recently completed a seven hours and 11 minutes spacewalk to install a new roll-out solar array on the station's truss structure. After releasing the tension bolts, the solar panel unfurled on its own.

Source: NASA.
